湾区雨天带孩子去哪：OMCA 与 The Tech，两种半日备选: Rainy-day outings with kids: OMCA and The Tech, two half-day options
按孩子的兴趣选一馆，把入场、吃饭和安静休息一起准备: Choose one museum around your child's interests, and plan admission, food, and quiet breaks together
比较 Oakland 的艺术自然观察与 San Jose 的科技动手体验，分清两: Compare art and nature at Oakland's museum with hands-on science in San Jose. Check each venue's tickets, food rules, and age considerations, and choose a few goals for an unrushed rainy-day outing.
想安排室内半日活动的人: People planning an indoor half-day outing
BAYLINK 原创周末生活整理，路线为编辑建议，未声称实地带队体验。出发前请通: Original BAYLINK weekend guide. Routes are editorial suggestions, not claimed first-hand guided experiences. Before leaving, use the official links at the end to check opening hours, reservations, site rules, and transportation. Map buttons locate places only.
查看展厅、儿童自然游戏空间、饮食与参观安排。: Check galleries, the children's nature play space, food rules, and visit arrangements.
核对成人及儿童票、预约入场和现场余票限制。: Check adult and child tickets, timed admission, and limits on tickets available on site.
核对购票建议、儿童陪同、食饮、感官支持及参观准备。: Check ticket recommendations, adult supervision, food and drink rules, sensory support, and visit preparation.
按孩子兴趣查看当前动手设计与科技探索内容，不保证单场活动当天开放。: Explore current hands-on design and technology offerings based on your child's interests. A particular activity is not guaranteed to be open that day.
雨天换计划，最容易把“有屋顶”当成全部准备。实际决定体验的，往往是孩子喜欢什么、: When rain changes your plans, it's easy to think a roof is all you need. What often shapes the experience is your child's interests, attention span, meals, and breaks. Here are two options: Oakland Museum of California (OMCA) and The Tech Interactive in San Jose. Choose one based on where you're starting and what interests your family; don't rush between both cities in one day.
先选观察型还是动手型: Choose observation or hands-on exploration first
喜欢找细节、讲故事、观察自然，可以先看 OMCA 的 California Ar: If your child enjoys details, stories, and nature, start with OMCA's California Art, History, and Natural Sciences collections. Its Nature Playspace is listed for children ages two to five and their caregivers. That age range applies to the space, not the whole museum. Choose one theme and enter with a small question your child can answer.
喜欢搭建、试验、反复调整，可以浏览 The Tech 的互动展项，找动手设计或科: If your child enjoys building, experimenting, and adjusting things, browse The Tech's interactive exhibits for hands-on design or technology exploration. Specific workshops, lab experiences, and movies may have separate times or requirements; check that day's page. “Let's try something new” is safer than promising a particular activity.
票要把孩子也算进去: Include the children when checking tickets
OMCA 的 FAQ 说明，所有进入展厅的访客都需要票，符合免费条件的孩子也要准: OMCA's FAQ says every gallery visitor needs a ticket, including children eligible for free admission. Walk-up availability isn't guaranteed. Check tickets for adults and kids and the selected time together. The Tech recommends buying tickets ahead; that shouldn't be described as a mandatory reservation for everyone. Check each museum's official site for temporary closures, special exhibitions, and admission conditions.
半天只设两个主要目标: Choose just two main goals for a half-day
抵达后先找卫生间、休息处和工作人员，处理湿外套，再开始看展。: On arrival, locate restrooms, rest areas, and staff, deal with wet coats, then begin exploring.
第一段由孩子从事先选好的两个主题里挑一个，不要求按楼层全部走完。: For the first part of the visit, let your child choose between two themes you've selected in advance. You don't need to cover every floor.
中途离开展项休息，补水或吃东西前确认指定区域；若需离馆再入，先问当日规则。: Take a break away from exhibits midway through. Check designated areas before drinking or eating. Ask about same-day reentry rules before leaving the building.
第二段重复最喜欢的体验，或看一个新主题，精力下降就结束，不靠赶场“回本”。: For the second part, repeat a favorite activity or try one new topic. Leave when energy drops; don't rush around to “get your money's worth.”
大人可以少问知识测验式的问题，多问“你刚才改了什么”“这里和家附近有什么不同”。: Adults can ask fewer quiz-style questions and more questions like “What did you just change?” or “How is this different from our neighborhood?” If a child doesn't want to participate, let them watch others first; there's no need to try every interactive exhibit. Before leaving, ask them to choose one thing they'd like to tell someone about—a clear takeaway from the visit.
水瓶和零食，不能按同一套规定带: Water bottles and snacks follow different rules
OMCA 展厅不允许食物、瓶装水和其他饮品，密封放在包内可以携带；馆方另有母乳及: OMCA does not allow food, bottled water, or other drinks in galleries unless sealed inside a bag. It has separate guidance for breastfeeding and bottle-feeding; check it if needed. The Tech allows fully closable water bottles, kept closed while using exhibits, but other food and drinks cannot be consumed in exhibit areas. Bringing lunch does not mean you can eat anywhere inside. Plan a meal location before buying tickets.
安静休息与成人陪同也写进准备单: Include quiet breaks and adult supervision in your plan
出发当天核对开放、入场票和选定展项，把确认信息保存到手机。: Check opening hours, admission tickets, and selected exhibits on the day, and save confirmations on your phone.
按各馆规则装好水瓶、食物和换洗用品，约好一位成人负责物品、一位照看孩子。: Pack water bottles, food, and spare clothes according to each museum's rules. Agree which adult handles belongings and which watches the children.
提前看感官或无障碍说明；The Tech 提供感官指南与相关资源，借用装备的可用: Read sensory or accessibility information in advance. The Tech offers a sensory guide and related resources; check equipment availability on site.
同行孩子年龄不同时，先分清照护安排；The Tech 对十岁以下儿童有全程陪同要: If the children are different ages, agree on supervision first. The Tech requires children under ten to be accompanied at all times.
把馆外步行、停车或乘车的雨天时间算进去，不把户外花园当成一定能用的休息区。: Allow extra rainy-day time for walking outside, parking, or transit. Don't count on outdoor gardens as a usable rest area.
如果当天人多、某项关闭或孩子不适应声音，改成短参观也合理。临时买票前先确认还有适: A shorter visit is reasonable if it is crowded, an activity is closed, or your child is uncomfortable with noise. Before buying last-minute tickets, check that there is still something suitable for you. That's easier than debating destinations at the entrance. Note what you'd like to try next time and leave something to look forward to. A rainy day doesn't need to be packed full.
约一家节奏相近的亲子同行: Find another family that enjoys a similar pace
选定一馆，写明孩子年龄段、集合时间、是否已备票与预计结束时间；照护责任由各家庭事: Choose one museum and specify children's age ranges, the meeting time, whether tickets are ready, and the expected end time. Each family should agree on supervision responsibilities in advance.
